description: This Python source file implements a logging handler class 'LeastBusyLoggingHandler' that manages request load balancing using a least busy deployment strategy in a machine learning inference routing context. It logs API call events, tracks request counts per deployment, and selects the least busy deployment among healthy ones, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: LeastBusyLoggingHandler
classes.description: A custom logging handler class that tracks request counts in a cache and implements a least busy deployment selection strategy based on current traffic, supporting both sync and async methods.

methods.description: Logs a successful response, decrementing the request count in the cache accordingly.

methods.name: log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a failed response, decrementing the request count in the cache accordingly.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failed response, decrementing the request count.

methods.description: Helper method to select the least busy deployment from healthy ones based on cached request counts.

methods.description: Synchronously retrieves the least busy deployment for a given model group.
